a launches on src_clk; b and q form a two-stage dst_clk synchronizer with a consistent destination reset. Each reset is timed to its own clock by the supplied contract. Separate source/destination resets alone do not establish a malformed level synchronizer; no event or retained-state protocol is claimed.
